request: 设置中添加默认关闭的外网授权，手机扫码/其他设备网页密码登录；加密传输；开启后锁屏超时不能0
acceptance: 默认关闭局域网授权，主端口仍仅宿主回环；打开独立TLS入口
手机扫码二维码仅含HTTPS地址；任何设备须密码登录，绝不返回主access-token
关闭/改密码/锁屏/空闲超时撤销远程会话，TLS-only与来源校验
开启必须已有密码；0锁屏超时自动300秒，开启后服务端拒绝0
设置修改自动保存；主页面/窄屏实际渲染和正反向鉴权测试
Mac/Linux/Windows现有宿主helper适配；不改现有服务、不Release
scope: internal/server 远程TLS入口/会话/设置
internal/messaging 固定目的地局域网租约
internal/server/web 设置/手机密码页与二维码

requirements.summary: 用户选择基于局域网；无需公网隧道。继承现有host桥，以单独固定TLS端口暴露经过密码会话保护的workbench。
evidence: user: 基于局域网的方案实现

design.summary: Separate TLS listener, fixed-target host relay, password-verified per-device tokens. LAN consent cannot be activated by backup import; preserve localhost certificate.

implementation.summary: Implemented auto-save consent, phone password page, credential-free QR, finite idle timeout, TLS/origin enforcement, revocation and legacy helper argument compatibility. No deployment.

verification.summary: Final quick, auth race, complete messaging race, vet, 6 launcher tests, Windows AMD64 native compile and six-platform host bridge compile pass. Actual Playwright workbench/phone UI and ZXing QR decode pass. Physical device validation NOT_RUN.

documentation.summary: Documented usage, certificate trust, session lifecycle, host helper integration and verification limits.

cleanup.summary: Closed only owned QA browser pages and isolated container. Deleted owned synthetic test/native/helper binaries; retained logs, screenshots, SDK cache and existing user service/workspace.
evidence: docker ps: user service retained; owned UI fixture stopped

release.summary: Source integration and push only under existing user authorization. No Release, version bump, tag or user service replacement.
evidence: user: source push/main only; no Release

release_authorization: Source integration and push main only; no Release/tag/version bump or deployment
rollback: Disable LAN access to revoke sessions and relay lease. Reverse task commits for source rollback; no data or localhost certificate migration.
handoff: User device certificate trust, LAN/firewall and Windows startup remain NOT_RUN. Running user instance unchanged.
